content: अभिगम् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To go to, go near to, approach (with <ab>acc.</ab>); एनमभिजग्मुर्महर्षयः <ls>R. 15. 59</ls>; <ls>Ki. 10. 21</ls>; मनुमेकाग्रमासीनमभिगम्य महर्षयः <ls>Ms. 1. 1</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">11. 100</ls>. .²2 To follow; go after; अनुरागाद्वने रामं दिष्ट्या त्वमभिगच्छसि <ls>Rām.</ls> .²3 To find; meet with (casually or by chance). .²4 To cohabit; have sexual intercourse (with man or woman); अभिगन्तास्मि भगिनीं मातरं वा तवेति ह <ls>Y. 2. 205</ls>; अभ्यगच्छः पतिं यत्त्वं भजमानम् <ls>Mb.</ls> .²5 To take to, undertake, betake oneself to. .²6 To get, to share in; be subject to; निद्रामभिगतः <ls>Rām.</ls> .²7 To conceive, apprehend, understand, comprehend. . --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to go to or approach; take, convey; send; <ls>Dk. 102</ls>. .²2 To cause to apprehend; explain, teach.
